'''Per Bolund''' (born 3 July 1971) is a [[Sweden|Swedish]] politician for the [[Green Party (Sweden)|Green Party]]. He served as [[Deputy Prime Minister of Sweden]] (in a strictly ceremonial role) and as [[Minister for the Environment (Sweden)|Minister for the Environment]] from February to November 2021, and was co-spokesperson of the [[Green Party (Sweden)|Green Party]] from May 2019<ref name="mp">{{cite web |url=https://www.mp.se/om/per-bolund |title=Per Bolund |publisher=[[Green Party (Sweden)|Green Party]]|language=sv|accessdate=2019-07-15}}</ref> until his resignation in November 2023.

He previously served as [[Minister for Financial Markets (Sweden)|Minister for Financial Markets]] from October 2014 to February 2021<ref>{{cite web|url=https://next.ft.com/content/93a39da4-aeff-11e5-993b-c425a3d2b65a|title=Per Bolund: Sweden's great Green pensions hope|work=Financial Times|accessdate=18 April 2016}}</ref> and as [[Minister for Housing (Sweden)|Minister for Housing]] from January 2019 to February 2021. He was shortly acting [[Ministry of Enterprise (Sweden)|Minister for Housing and Urban Development]] from April to May 2016.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://sverigesradio.se/sida/artikel.aspx?programid=83&artikel=6413378|title=Direktrapport om Kaplans avgång|language=sv|author=Sveriges Radio|publisher=|accessdate=18 April 2016}}</ref>

Bolund was elected to the [[Riksdag]] in 2006. As [[Minister for the Environment (Sweden)|Minister for the Environment]] he made a pledge to double Sweden's climate finance.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|date=2021-11-08|title=A Swiss pianist, a Rwandan chemist... meet 15 ministers brokering a deal in Glasgow|url=https://www.climatechangenews.com/2021/11/08/swiss-pianist-rwandan-chemist-meet-15-ministers-brokering-glasgow-pact/|access-date=2021-11-25|website=Climate Home News|language=en}}</ref> As leader of the  [[Green Party (Sweden)|Green Party]] his withdrawal of support helped bring down the government of [[Magdalena Andersson]] in November 2021 because the planned tax cut on petrol in her first budget would lead to higher emissions.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Stockholm|first=Agencies in|date=2021-11-24|title=Sweden's first female prime minister resigns after less than 12 hours|url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/nov/24/swedens-first-female-prime-minister-resigns-after-less-than-12-hours|access-date=2021-11-25|website=the Guardian|language=en}}</ref>

Before politics he trained as a biologist, and his parents are the [[Aarhus University]] geneticist Professor Lars Bolund and medical Professor Christina Bolund.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Riksdagsförvaltningen|title=Per Bolund (MP) - Riksdagen|url=https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/ledamoter-partier/ledamot/per-bolund_56698f88-e33a-41fe-9c62-a9c53b3e793d|access-date=2021-11-25|website=www.riksdagen.se|language=sv}}</ref> In his personal time he is a fan of baseball and football, and follows the Stockholm club [[AIK Fotboll]].<ref name=":0" />
